community_list_entries.name: ICM-Bench: Person-Level Identity Reasoning in Multimodal Agents with Long-Term Memory

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Identity-centric memory benchmark over a chronological stream of 839 synthetic life-album video clips (141 min) with 1,217 questions. Categories are identity recall, cross-episode identity retrieval and long-term identity profile inference, with temporal cutoffs per question.
